name: makarasty-tools
description: Six small commands that travel with the fleet plugin but are versioned apart from it: commit under your own name, ship (merge branches in, split the work into your own commits, push, tag with patch notes), review a diff and report only findings with evidence, strip assistant tics out of writing, say what you mean in simple English a person can read aloud to a vendor, and get one message on your phone when a chat you walked away from finishes.

hooks.command: for f in "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"/makarasty/notify/*.json; do [ -e "$f" ] && exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/notify.mjs"; break; done; true
